posts.title: Your PR Shouldn’t Make Your Stomach Hurt
posts.description: > If a pull request makes your stomach hurt, another round of AI review might not be the answer. John and Garrett compare the workflows that keep changes small, explain how feature flags helped move Fireside’s file storage, and talk about what to watch when support gets suspiciously quiet. Permalink

posts.title: Changing the Wheels While the Car Is Moving
posts.description: > AI can write the migration plan, inspect the servers, and even carry the work to the finish line. It still cannot decide what complexity is worth adding. John and Garrett talk about rebuilding Fireside, verifying dangerous changes, and why taste remains the difference between generating code and shipping dependable software. Permalink

posts.title: The SaaS Checkup: What You Should Audit Every Year (But Probably Don’t)
posts.description: > John, Kris, and Garrett sit down for a deep dive into what a regular “SaaS physical” should look like. From onboarding emails to customer segmentation and pricing strategy, they break down the checkups every founder should be doing—but rarely are. Permalink
